file_info.description: Mode 2: Face Consistency - Preserves specific model identity using Master Image

prompts.Command: A RAW, true-to-life portrait photograph where preserving the EXACT facial identity of the human in the [MASTER_IMG] is the ABSOLUTE HIGHEST PRIORITY, cosplaying the costume and pose from the [REFERENCE_IMG].

Identity Protection: Treat the face in the [MASTER_IMG] as an unchangeable master template.
Even when applying expressions from the [REFERENCE_IMG], the underlying bone structure, facial width-to-length ratio, and the subject's core identity must remain 100% consistent and unaltered.
Appearance & Proportions: (ABSOLUTE PRIORITY) Anchor and firmly lock the exact facial identity of the person in the [MASTER_IMG].
There is ZERO TOLERANCE for any facial feature leakage from the character in the [REFERENCE_IMG].

You must strictly analyze and fixate the biometric-level details of the [MASTER_IMG]: the specific eye-lid fold, the exact bridge of the nose, the unique curve of the lips, and the authentic East Asian (Korean) facial topography.
Facial Expression Transfer: Accurately replicate the emotional nuance from the [REFERENCE_IMG], including the degree of eye squinting, mouth corner angles, and gaze direction.
However, you must strictly ensure that the original facial features and identity of the [MASTER_IMG] are not distorted or altered while the subject is making the expression.
